title: Planet Tweaks V2.8.5 NOVA TITAN 🪐 — Supabase Auth, Permanent GamerTag & AI Copilot Remodel
releaseNotes: Cloud Architecture & AI UI Overhaul: Completely migrated authentication from Firebase to native Supabase Auth REST API with Google OAuth browser login. Fixed permanent GamerTag persistence so custom usernames never revert to PlanetGamer. Scrubbed user-facing API key input boxes with automated background credential resolution. Remodeled Gemini AI Assistant UI with full-height message flex and pinned bottom prompt inputs. Cleaned nested Random Tab container encoding.
